Synopsis:
Shell is acquiring full ownership of Tri Star Energy, a U.S. convenience store and fuel distribution operator, by purchasing the remaining 67% stake from The Parman Corporation, Kimbro Oil Company, and their units. The deal adds 320 company-controlled fuel/convenience sites in Tennessee and surrounding states, plus supply agreements covering 552 dealer-owned locations, expanding Shell's existing ~12,000 U.S. retail fuel network. Financial terms were undisclosed; closing expected by end of 2026.
